name: Admin Accounting Hostings
description: Superuser manages the client hosting registry at /panel/accounting/hostings: list with an inline estado select, validity, 4 KPI cards and modal CRUD. New records offer exactly quarterly, semiannual and every-9-month payment modalities, with payment_per_cycle derived from the monthly value. Legacy monthly/annual rows remain readable as historical values but cannot be selected for new records. Ciclos/total pagado are read-only in the form. Cliente renders the linked relation and Proyecto is a column of its own.
